notes: Full-size tri-mode board with a 240×135 screen on the AJAZZ Windows-driver protocol (0C45:800A, product string "AULA F108Pro"). The vendor configuration caps animations at 141 frames: a longer upload overwrote the keyboard's built-in menu graphics in the source's test.

usb.evidence: Vendor config.xml mode 0 (0C45:800A, "AULA F108Pro"); lighting, per-key, clock and screen upload verified by parsiya/f108-pro on the keyboard.

2.4ghz.evidence: Vendor config.xml mode 2 (05AC:024F "F108Pro Dongle") uses a simplified single-packet protocol; not implemented.

bluetooth.evidence: The vendor software does not configure Bluetooth links.

knob.note: The volume knob is firmware-controlled; the vendor software has no knob setting.

evidence: AULA F108 Pro driver v1.0.0.1/v1.0.0.3 as analysed by the source
